name: Tray
note: Print back face on the bed, no supports (windows bridge 13.5 mm). Pi: four M2.5 x 6 thread-forming screws. Lid: six M3 x 10 thread-forming screws into the ears.

name: Lid
note: Print outer face on the bed, posts up, no supports. Camera: four M2 x 6 thread-forming screws. Control PCB: four M2 x 6 (two switch posts, two LED posts). The LED dome sits in a 5.5 mm hole with a light collar.

name: ButtonCap
note: Print flange on the bed, no supports. Drop it into the lid hole from inside before the switch goes on.

name: ButtonCarrier
note: Superseded by the control PCB (../pcb-pi4-controls), which has the same thickness and screw holes. Print flat, no supports. Switch terminals go through the four slots; two M2 x 6 screws into the lid posts.

name: PiFitCoupon
note: Bottom 15 mm of the Tray up to the upper Pi posts: hole pattern, USB-C and HDMI windows, microSD slot.

name: LidFitCoupon
note: Camera end of the Lid: camera posts, lens bore and collar, cap hole, switch posts, LED collar.
